scheme_name: National Handloom Development Programme: Concessional Credit/Weaver MUDRA Scheme
other_conditions: Individual weavers who have already received margin money assistance are not eligible for further margin money assistance, interest subvention, or credit guarantee fee under organisational schemes
Fresh loans can be sanctioned only after one year of repayment of any previous Mudra loan
Loans up to ₹10 lakh are covered under MUDRA, while loans above ₹10 lakh are covered under concessional credit
Margin money assistance for handloom organisations is provided on recommendation of the State Director of Handlooms
Interest subvention and credit guarantee fee are available only to eligible handloom organisations
Benefits for individual weavers (interest subsidy and credit guarantee fee) are limited to three years from the first disbursal and are not available for fresh loans thereafter
benefits_summary: Provides margin money assistance up to ₹25,000 for individual weavers and up to ₹20 lakh for handloom organisations, together with a 6% concessional interest rate for three years and credit guarantee coverage for loans up to ₹1 crore.
